x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.releaseEvidencePath: Derive the only accepted T-012 evidence path as `.mallok/evidence/T-012/${candidateSha}.json`; callers may not supply another path.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.releaseEvidenceExactBytes: releaseEvidenceSha256 is SHA-256 over the exact evidence-file bytes, not parsed or reserialized JSON. The evidence file must not contain its own exact-bytes digest.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.timeWindow: Normal remote actions require issuedAt <= now < expiresAt. Cleanup requires now < cleanupDeadline. expiresAt must be later than issuedAt, cleanupDeadline must be later than expiresAt, and both deadlines must be no later than issuedAt plus 24 hours.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.exclusiveCreate: authorization.json must be created owner-only with exclusive-create semantics and must never replace an existing marker.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.allowedActionOrder: allowedActions must contain the exact closed set and be serialized in Unicode code-unit ascending order.

allowedActionScopes.inspectAccount: Read only the exact provider account identity needed to verify accountIdHash; no logs, analytics, billing mutation, broad account discovery or unrelated account reads.
allowedActionScopes.inspectResources: Read exact-name/exact-id Worker and D1 existence, schema/migration/deployment metadata, journaled version-observation for the current logical upload attempt, poll only operation ids produced by this run, and perform exact residual checks. Version observation must exhaust the bounded provider result set and match exact tag/message/four hashes. Provider list calls are permitted only for these exact lookups and must filter to workerName/databaseName or the current version annotation; no logs, analytics or unrelated resources.
allowedActionScopes.createD1: Create exactly databaseName in the verified account, at most once.
allowedActionScopes.applyMigrations: Apply only the accepted Mallok migration set to the D1 id recorded as created by this run.
allowedActionScopes.deployWorker: For exactly workerName and the accepted immutable candidate, permit only a journaled non-activating Worker version upload followed, after its canonical target UUID is persisted, by a separately journaled exact-target 100% activation. Recovery may repeat the same effect-idempotent logical upload/activation with a fresh providerCallId. A combined upload-and-activate deploy, a different target/candidate, or an unjournaled provider call is forbidden.
allowedActionScopes.verifyHealth: Authenticated GET only to https://expectedPublicHostname/__mallok/api/v1/health with manual redirects and the frozen response budget.
allowedActionScopes.publishFixture: Publish only this run's fixed fixture document id to the exact staging admin endpoint.
allowedActionScopes.readPublicFixture: GET/HEAD only on expectedPublicHostname for the fixture article, home, rss.xml, sitemap.xml and exact manifest asset URLs; no arbitrary paths or cross-host redirects.
allowedActionScopes.unpublishFixture: Unpublish only this run's fixed fixture document id from the exact staging admin endpoint.
allowedActionScopes.deleteCreatedWorker: Delete only the exact Worker id/name whose ownership entry is action=created for this run, after terminal-outcome proof.
allowedActionScopes.deleteCreatedD1: Delete only the exact D1 id/name whose ownership entry is action=created for this run, after terminal-outcome proof.

candidateSha.description: Also determines `.mallok/evidence/T-012/<candidateSha>.json`; no evidence path is accepted from the caller.

expiresAt.description: Runtime permits non-cleanup remote actions only while issuedAt <= now < expiresAt; requires expiresAt > issuedAt and expiresAt no later than issuedAt + 24 hours.

cleanupDeadline.description: Cleanup may continue after expiresAt only while now < cleanupDeadline. Runtime requires expiresAt < cleanupDeadline <= issuedAt + 24 hours.

releaseEvidenceSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes at the candidate-derived T-012 evidence path. It is computed by staging:authorize and is not a caller-supplied value.
